# Agent guide

## Continuity

- A brief of current state, ready tasks and relevant spec sections is injected at session start.
- More context on demand: `.context/spec.md` (intent), `.context/decisions/` (why), `.context/knowledge/` (how-to and gotchas).
- `baton mission --task <id>` prints the brief for one task.
